decision_rule: AK-ASM-T1 harness r3. Retarget is 782/782 non-fp8 (R7 cmpswap loop, R8 load-lds emulation, R9 scratch spill when no VGPR/AGPR is dead: private segment enabled, user/system SGPRs shifted back by an entry prologue, 4 VGPRs spilled per-lane around the site). Units: NEW fmoe-16bit (fmoe_b16.co, spill path) and fmoe-g1u0-int8smoothquant -id 1024 (subGU_512, spill path); REGRESSION fmoe-g1u0 -id 384/768, fmoe-g1u1-int8smoothquant, fmoe-g1u1-int8quant, topksoftmax, pa-bf16, pa-fp16, mhc_seam, i8gemm, fmha_v3_fwd (fwd-only script); 1-ULP QUESTION bf16gemm-bf16out (split-K through R7) vs bf16gemm-fp32out (f32 atomics, no R7). PASS = >=1 LoadKernel from hsa/gfx90a/<family> AND >=1 family check AND all pass, max_abs reported; FAIL = any family check fails; ERROR = infra/not exercised/vacuous. Decision: PASS families eligible for the AK-ASM timing/serving lane; a spill-path FAIL/HANG convicts R9; bf16out FAIL with fp32out PASS localises the 1-ulp gap to bf16 split-K accumulation (R7 or inherent; needs a native-gfx942 or bit-emulated comparison). Stop rule: single pass, no repeats; per-unit timeout 1800-3600 s (JIT build included) + 600 s no-output watchdog after a gfx90a load; any HANG writes out/HANG.json and stops the packet (rc 3); STOP/deadline rc 75 resumable; stale aiter/jit/build/lock_* moved aside at start when no harness container runs. Smoke = smoke_hold.py: ONE process, >= 50 s GPU residency (256 MiB ballast), retargeted topksoftmax vs torch.
